title: Wikipedia Trend Analysis Pipeline
description: Personal project, ongoing. Building a production-style ELT pipeline to collect and store Wikimedia pageview data for large-scale trend analysis. Implemented append-only raw ingestion with explicit data contracts and ingestion metadata; planned extensions include dbt transformations, workflow orchestration, and machine learning for automated trend detection.

title: Character-Level Text Generation (Char-RNN)
description: UCSD project. Built an LSTM-based character-level language model to generate Reddit titles from approximately 14M sequences. Developed regex cleaning, encoding, and sequence-generation preprocessing, then evaluated architectures, sequence lengths, and sampling temperatures to improve coherence while reducing overfitting.

title: Mini ETL Data Pipeline
description: Personal project. Built a modular ETL pipeline to collect e-commerce product data with Python and SQL. Designed reusable Pandas workflows for cleaning, structuring, and loading raw data, improving maintainability through modular processing components.

title: Trail Difficulty Analysis & Prediction
description: UCSD project. Built an end-to-end machine learning pipeline to classify hiking trail difficulty using 3,000+ US trails, including preprocessing, feature selection, and model evaluation. Engineered features such as trail gradient and tuned Logistic Regression and Random Forest models.
